rows.independentBacktranslation: Compacted soil loses air spaces. Roots grow slowly. Water enters differently. The bed becomes progressively harder to work each season.
rows.semanticReason: “i ya u konḓa” is proposed to retain the becoming-harder comparison; “Bed” remains the current familiar term. The compacted-soil phrase describes physical compression and air-space loss, not a new soil category.
rows.languageReviewUncertainty: Native Tshivenda review needed to confirm the progressive construction and concord; if it only means “is difficult each season,” retain the exact source comparison until revised.
